title: Send and restore company copies
summary: Send an encrypted copy of the company to an accountant, and put back a version a copy replaced.

steps.text: On {title}, enter the {firm} and the {to} and send. Celerp encrypts the copy on your computer before it leaves.
{title} lists every copy you sent, with who it went to and how it stands. Revoke a copy's link, or send a new one.
Each time a copy replaces this company, {title} keeps the version it replaced until you delete it, so you can download it or put it back.
You can also ask the assistant which copies you sent, or to revoke a copy's link. It shows each change as a card and makes it only when you confirm.
